shown.message:
I redrew four items on the refreshed analysis tables and pushed them to `paper-repo` `dev` (daf4b8e) and `figtab-repo` `main`. I checked each redrawn figure by eye. I haven't re-checked type sizes or page fit in a system build, so I can't say yet whether the main text still fits nine pages.

- **Coverage population:** the new fine-p runs were leaking into the coverage selector, which pushed the count from 1800 to 1818 cells. The selector now excludes them, so Fig 9 and Table A3 stay at the 1800 cells analysis confirmed.
- **Fig 3 and Fig A4:** the fine grid p = 0.35–0.65 for (c) at d = 20 is drawn. A4 also draws it for (g) as open markers. The (c) zero crossing at d = 20 is 0.397 [0.393, 0.401], now bracketed by measured points.
- **Fig 7:** each of panels A and B states its absolute held-out R² of log RMSE (0.32 and 0.29) and the held-out constant's (−0.05) in its title. The dotted line is the held-out constant prediction rather than the mean log RMSE. The figure is 3 pt taller (390 × 319 pt).
- **Table 2:** the "R² abs." column now also holds log RMSE R² for criteria (1), (1′) and the exploratory S_adj row. A new reference block gives, leaving out one mechanism / one family, the best benchmark, L alone, the controls and the constant.
- **Removed constant:** the "constant = 0" value the table carried for log|bias| was my own assumption, so I removed it. I asked analysis for the real value on `experiment-repo`#9.
- **Moved values:** the log|bias| absolute R² values moved with the refresh, now on 1224 cells. The text should quote these new values.
- **Captions and notes:** `figures/CAPTIONS.md` and `REPRODUCE.md` are updated. A suggested Fig 5 sentence on why the `or_fit` row is unstable at d ≥ 20 is in `CAPTIONS.md` and on `figtab-repo`#3 for the report role.

My first comment about the redraws landed on `paper-repo`#3 by mistake, because my working directory had changed. I deleted it and posted it on `figtab-repo`#3 (comment 139).

The P6 interval panel for Fig 9 is still not drawn, because that table doesn't exist yet. `figtab-repo`#2 stays open until it does.
